title: RES↔SEC-001: Pre-Transfer Security Review + Threat Assessment
description: Researcher submits a Pre-Transfer Security Review briefing (flagged findings + attack-surface categories) ≥ 10 business days before a Technology Transfer; Security returns a STRIDE threat-model assessment within 10 business days. This gate must complete before the Technology Transfer Pack (RES↔ARCH-TTP-001) is finalized. Grounded in SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.10 and IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.9.

linked_ttp.description: The Technology Transfer Pack this review gates (RES↔ARCH-TTP-001).

stride_assessment.description: SEC→RES: STRIDE threat-model assessment (delivered within 10 business days of briefing).

baseline_compatible.description: Whether the finding aligns with the organizational security baseline.

verdict.description: INCOMPATIBLE = fundamentally incompatible with the security baseline.

required_controls.description: Additional production controls required when verdict = CLEARED_WITH_CONTROLS.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Pre-Transfer Security Review gate — ESC-SEC; SEC owns the binding threat assessment. Novel attack surfaces may trigger ESC-NOV. Gate must complete before TTP finalization.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (briefing submitted ≥ 10 business days before Technology Transfer); SLA_FROM_EVENT (SEC returns assessment within 10 business days; high-complexity novel modalities within 20)
confirm_conditions: each finding carries an attack_surface_category and ≥ 20-char description
stride_assessment evaluates all six STRIDE categories
verdict = CLEARED (or CLEARED_WITH_CONTROLS with required_controls listed)
review completed before the linked TTP is finalized
reject_conditions: verdict = INCOMPATIBLE (finding conflicts with the security baseline — blocks transfer)
TTP finalized without a completed Pre-Transfer Security Review
counter_conditions: novel modality requiring high-complexity assessment — request the 20-business-day window (ESC-NOV)
security assumptions unclear — request elaboration before STRIDE scoring
